system.description: Activate for a Blood Trait to last the scene. Whenever attacked, win a Simple Test to cause any melee weapon that strikes you to shatter and become unusable, an unarmed striker's hand or foot to be shattered and disabled, or a headbutter to take double damage and be stunned for a round; the stake used to attempt to stake you also shatters harmlessly. Bullets still deal damage even as they shatter, and non-physical attacks (such as Fire Bolt) are unaffected.
